behaviors.description: Roundtrip installed-ref and remote-ref public EOL properties.
behaviors.preconditions: Constructed objects receive explicit reason/rebase properties or NULL; neither object is obtained by querying metadata.
behaviors.expected: All four getters return the literal properties, including NULL. This partial getter test earns no installed or remote EOL metadata requirement credit.
references: common/flatpak-installed-ref.c: public end-of-life properties and getters
common/flatpak-remote-ref.c: public end-of-life properties and getters

behaviors.preconditions: Constructed objects receive literal version, MIT license, OARS type and two rating attributes or NULL; no AppStream document is loaded.
behaviors.expected: Version, license, type and complete rating map match the supplied properties; missing values return NULL. This partial getter test earns no AppStream metadata requirement credit.
references: common/flatpak-installed-ref.c: public appdata properties and getters

behaviors.description: Read deployed metadata, location, origin and size.
behaviors.preconditions: App exported by reference tooling, expected exact metadata and size recorded before target execution.
behaviors.expected: Byte-exact metadata with runtime and permissions; origin queries; deployment directory holds matching metadata and fixture payload; size matches exported commit.

behaviors.description: Load embedded appdata from an installed app.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared compressed AppStream and controlled C locale.
behaviors.expected: Decompressed XML has exactly the fixture elements, attributes and text, ignoring formatting whitespace; name and summary equal literal fields.

behaviors.description: Read full and partial deployment subpaths.
behaviors.preconditions: One full app and another directly installed with /bin only.
behaviors.expected: Full getter is NULL; partial getter has exactly /bin and terminator.

behaviors.description: Read release and rating fields from actual deployed AppStream.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent rich Query app and QuerySecond without optional AppStream fields.
behaviors.expected: Exact version, MIT license, oars-1.1 type and single violence-cartoon=none attribute; all optional getters NULL for second app.

behaviors.description: Read actual installed and remote end-of-life metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent transaction A, EOL and REBASE commits.
behaviors.expected: Both typed refs expose absent, reason-only and reason-plus-full-rebase values matching independent exports.

mappings.rationale: Expected exported metadata bytes and exact size, literal origin and real payload at reported deployment directory asserted.
Full decompressed XML structure, attributes, text and literal name/summary checked on a deployed reference-exported app.
Actual full and partial deployments expose NULL and exact single-element subpaths respectively.
Real rich and field-absent deployments exercise all four typed getters including exact attribute membership and NULL cases.
Both typed installed and remote getters checked against independently exported absent, EOL-only and rebase metadata.
